title: Bettis lab, naval nuclear power and western PA UFO sightings

tellings.quote: Bettis research lab up in Pittsburgh and they were the first people to develop nuclear power for the Navy and that was in the 50s and you get into Kexsburg and all the UFO sightings in the western PA region.

plain: Bettis, a research lab near Pittsburgh, was the first to develop nuclear power for the Navy in the 1950s, and a guest named Dylan Borland ties it to the many UFO sightings in western Pennsylvania, including those around the town he calls Kexsburg. Borland makes the link to Michels without naming a source. His point is that the sightings cluster near secret nuclear work.
